correctness.rationale: For every nonzero sketch vector w, m_w(t)=w^T A^t w is an exponential sum with log-convex logarithm g. Comparing p g′(pt) with p g′(t) for t>=1 gives the exact pointwise quotient inequality for each Rayleigh quotient of the positive-definite generalized pencils (M_{2pq},M_{(2q-1)p}) and (M_{2q},M_{2q-1}). Courant–Fischer yields all k ordered eigenvalues. The PSD projector factorization for Nyström plus Löwner–Heinz yields both PSD fractional-power residuals, permitting a trace/nuclear comparison. The two-by-two family gives exact alpha and beta and ratio asymptotic 2 L^{1/4}. Symbolic verification and 1728 finite matrix-pencil comparisons passed; finite checks are not treated as proof of universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: For approximate traces of fractional matrix powers, both Nyström constructions are known and may have drastically different cost. The theorem provides an unconditional quantitative decision rule comparing their captured traces for the exact same sketch and number of subspace iterations, not just a generic near-optimality estimate; it rigorously explains the empirical advantage in the primary paper for the trace metric. The exact 2x2 family shows the alternative can have an arbitrarily larger trace/nuclear residual, so it is a meaningful structural separation, not an arbitrary small improvement. The scope is carefully restricted to the trace/nuclear residual and power functions.
